thread:
Zara Lin: Quick ops thread for tomorrow's webinar (10:30am PT). Need owners for: registration confirmation copy, Typeform->HubSpot mapping, Zoom recording + cloud upload, captions vendor handoff, and post-event clip/package for partners. Who can own which?
Theo Park: Ill co-host and take Zoom recording + upload. Will leave raw VTT and transcript JSON.
Aisha Rahman: I can draft confirmation + 24h/72h follow-ups. Will include calendar ICS, passcode, brief agenda, and caption note. Drafting now and will post in 20.
Marcus Lee: Content ops: Ill produce 2 highlight clips (2min each) + 1 social 30s and package partner bundles (MP4 + SRT + short README). Need sentence-level JSON for speed.
Zara Lin: S3 path convention: s3://redwood-marketing/events/2026-q4/{EVENT_SLUG}/. Theo please include speakers.yaml with start offsets and cloud_recording_id.txt.
Theo Park: Upload snippet from runbook:
```
# upload and tag
aws s3 cp /tmp/zoom/recording.mp4 s3://redwood-marketing/events/2026-q4/${EVENT_SLUG}/recording.mp4 --acl private
aws s3 cp /tmp/zoom/transcript.json s3://redwood-marketing/events/2026-q4/${EVENT_SLUG}/transcript.json
aws s3 cp /tmp/zoom/transcript.vtt s3://redwood-marketing/events/2026-q4/${EVENT_SLUG}/transcript.vtt
```
Aisha Rahman: Typeform -> HubSpot mapping: email -> email, name -> firstname+lastname (split), company -> company, role -> job_title, consent -> marketing_opt_in. Add hidden utm_campaign=webinar_q4_2026 and lead_prop=webinar_interest.
Marcus Lee: Please leave raw VTT and transcript JSON. Ill convert to sentence-timestamped JSON and mark clip ranges. Also request cloud_recording_id in metadata to match versions.
legal-bot: Use standard distribution consent: "By registering you consent to on-demand distribution of the recording and short clips for marketing and educational purposes." See /legal/snippets/webinar_distribution_2026.txt.
ops-bot: Preflight reminder scheduled: 2026-11-18T17:45:00Z  mic check, co-host set, cloud recording ON, auto-caption ON. Will ping #marketing and #eng-oncall 15m before.
Theo Park: I'll enable "optimize for third party editor" and set Aisha + Marcus as co-hosts so they can manage the recording and start/stop if needed. Posting S3+CloudFront link here ~30m after session.
Aisha Rahman: Confirmation copy draft posted below: "Thanks for registering! Add to calendar [ICS]. Zoom link + passcode in your calendar invite. Recording emailed within 24 hours; captions available within 48 hours. By registering you consent to on-demand sharing and short clips." Please review.
Zara Lin: That copy looks good. Marcus, once clips are ready upload partner packages to s3 under /partners/{PARTNER_NAME}/{EVENT_SLUG}/ and include partner-readme.txt with timestamps and suggested captions.
Marcus Lee: Will do. ETA: 3 hours after upload for clips + partner bundles. I'll paste links here and ping @Aisha for copy approval.
Zara Lin: Final: after upload, post both internal S3 path and CloudFront share link for the 24h email. If cloud recording doesn't appear within 30m of end, ops-bot, please tag #eng-oncall. Thanks team. :rocket:
